title: Probability of a sum under convolution
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $\\phi,\\psi:(\\mathbb{F}_2)^n\\to\\mathbb{R}$ be pointwise nonnegative functions, each having uniform expectation $1$. For every subset $A\\subseteq(\\mathbb{F}_2)^n$, the probability assigned to $A$ by the convolution of these densities is $\\mathbb{E}_{y}\\mathbb{E}_{z}[\\phi(y)\\psi(z)\\mathbf{1}_A(y+z)]$, where both expectations are uniform on $(\\mathbb{F}_2)^n$.
hypotheses_covered: Each of $\\phi$ and $\\psi$ has uniform expectation $1$
